decision_conditions:
Condition : 1 - The development shall be carried out and maintained in accordance with the approved drawings and specifications: Cover letter by DP9 (dated 5 February 2026); Fire Strategy Report rev. 01 by mu.studio (dated 3 November 2025); Delivery and Servicing Plan - Phase 1 (RS1) Report by Steer Davies Gleave (dated July 2013); Battersea General Risk Assessment; Letter ref. R11148-1 rev. 0 (Re: MEplace Nursery, Battersea - Sound Transmission) by 24 Acoustics dated 22 May 2025; 0389_001_COU_01 (Unit UG001 - Change of Use - Location Plan); 0389_001_COU_02 (Unit UG001 - Change of Use - Existing Plan); 0389_001_COU_03 (Unit UG001 - Change of Use - Proposed Plan); and 24572-OSM-ZZ-ZZ-DR-A-101 rev. P04 (Unit UG001 - Proposed Fire Strategy).
Reason: To ensure a satisfactory standard of development and to allow the local planning authority to review any potential changes to the scheme. 
Condition : 2 - The development shall operate in accordance with the details and recommendations set out in the Fire Strategy Report rev. 01 by mu.studio (dated 3 November 2025) and the Battersea General Risk Assessment and thereafter be retained.
Reason: To reduce the risk of fire and flooding to the proposed development and its occupants, in accordance with London Plan policies D11, D12, SI12 and Local Plan policies LP2 and LP12, coupled with the requirements of the National Planning Policy Framework.
Condition : 3 - Refuse and recycling storage shall be made available for the development in accordance with the details set out in Delivery and Servicing Plan - Phase 1 (RS1) Report by Steer Davies Gleave (dated July 2013) and shall be retained for the users of the development and for no other purpose.
Reason: To ensure adequate provision is made for waste storage in accordance with policy LP2 of the Local Plan coupled with the requirements of the National Planning Policy Framework.
Condition : 4 - The pram store shown on drawing ref. 24572-OSM-ZZ-ZZ-DR-A-101 rev. P04 shall be retained to provide secured and covered cycle, buggy and scooter parking for the users of the development and for no other purpose. 
Reason: To ensure adequate provision is made within the unit and to encourage active travel, in accordance with Local Plan policies LP17 and LP49, and London Plan policy S3.
Condition : 5 - TThe use hereby permitted shall not be open to customers other than between the hours of 08:00-18:00 Monday to Friday.
Reason: To safeguard the amenities of the neighbourhood, in accordance with Council policy LP2 of the Local Plan coupled with the requirements of the National Planning Policy Framework.
Condition : 6 - Notwithstanding the provisions of the Town and Country Planning (General Permitted Development) (England) Order 2015 (as amended) or any Order revoking, amending and re-enacting the Order the development hereby approved be used only for Class E(f) and for no other purpose (including any other purpose in Class E of the Schedule to the Town and Country Planning (Use Classes) Order 1987, or in any provision equivalent to that Class in any statutory instrument revoking and re-enacting that Order with or without modification). In accordance with policies LP2, LP14 and LP17 of the Local Plan.
Reason: To protect the provision of the community facilities hereby approved and to safeguard the amenities of the neighbourhood by ensuring that other uses which could cause a loss of amenity do not commence without prior approval in accordance with the National Planning Policy Framework.
description: Change of use of Unit 1 Circus Road West from professional services (Use Class A2) to nursery (Use Class E(f)). (Retrospective application)
